title: Luxe Historical Condo Escape, Pool, Rooftop Deck
description:
Stay in a renovated two-bedroom condo inside The 1865, a historic Nashville landmark near Midtown. The home sleeps six with one king bed, one queen bed, and a living-room sofa bed. Enjoy a full kitchen, in-building laundry, gym, communal outdoor pool, BBQ area, dedicated workspace, and private entrance.

The space
The 1865 #107 is a renovated, single-level two-bedroom condo for up to six guests. Bedroom 1 has one king bed, Bedroom 2 has one queen bed, and the living room has one sofa bed. 

The home includes one full bathroom, a full kitchen with stainless-steel appliances, Wi-Fi, TVs, a sound system, board games, a dining table, and a dedicated workspace. The washer and dryer are located in the building. Shared property amenities include a gym, communal outdoor pool, and BBQ area. 

The 1865 is a historic Nashville building near Midtown, Centennial Park, Marathon Village, downtown attractions, hospitals, dining, and nightlife. Check-in is after 4:00 PM and checkout is before 10:00 AM. Smoking, pets, and parties or events are not allowed.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
| ▼ Important |

☑︎ Train tracks are located behind the property, and passing trains may occasionally be heard.
☑︎ There is ongoing construction next door, and noise may be heard during your stay.

| ▼ Things to Know |

☑︎ Check-in time: 4:00 PM
☑︎ Check-out time: 10:00 AM
☑︎ Quiet Hours: 10:00 PM - 8:00 AM
☑︎ All guests shall abide good neighbor policy and shall not engage in illegal activity.
☑︎ NO smoking is permitted anywhere on the premises.
☑︎ Streaming services available with guests’ own account(s)
